# @oge-ui/react-scheduler

> React scheduler / event calendar: day, work-week, week, month, agenda, timeline and year views, all-day strip, pure-kernel overlap layout, drag & resize with Escape-cancel, drag-to-create, recurrence with occurrence-vs-series editing, resource grouping, reminders, an appointment popup and a form editor — running the same scheduler engine and stylesheet as the Angular scheduler package.
>
> This package is commercially licensed — unlike the rest of the suite, it is not MIT. See https://www.ogeui.com/license before shipping it.

Part of OGE UI v1.1.3.
Docs and live demos: https://www.ogeui.com/components/scheduler
Whole-suite reference: https://www.ogeui.com/llms-full.txt

```sh
npm i @oge-ui/react-scheduler
```

## Writing OGE React code

Follow these rules and generated code compiles on the first try.

1. **These are plain React components.** Import the component and render it:
   `import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/react-buttons'`. There is no module, no
   provider requirement and no `imports` array — that is the Angular package.
2. **Import the stylesheet once, at your app entry.**
   `import '@oge-ui/react-buttons/styles.css'`. Components ship no inline
   styles; without this import they render unstyled.
3. **Props are plain props, not signals.** Write `text="Save"`,
   `severity="accent"`, `disabled`. Never call them (`text()`), and never use
   `[prop]`/`[(prop)]` binding syntax — that is Angular template syntax.
4. **Modes are string unions, never enums.** Write the literal:
   `severity="danger"`, `stylingMode="outlined"`, `size="sm"`,
   `selectionMode="single"`. There is no `OgeButtonSeverity.Danger`.
5. **Events are `on*` callbacks taking the payload directly** —
   `onClick={(event) => …}`, `onActionDone={(result) => …}`,
   `onSelectionChange={(change) => …}`. Note this is the mirror image of the
   Angular naming rule: there, outputs drop the `on` prefix; here React's
   convention wins, and the payload is the argument rather than an event object.
6. **Two-way state is the controlled/uncontrolled pair.** Pass `selectedKeys`
   plus `onSelectionChange` to control it yourself, or `defaultSelectedKeys`
   to let the component own it. Same for the button's `loading` /
   `onLoadingChange`.
7. **App-wide defaults and every user-facing string** come from a context
   provider: `<OgeButtonsConfigProvider config={{ clickGuardMs: 300,
   messages: { loading: 'Yükleniyor' } }}>`. That is how localization works;
   there is no i18n dependency. Per-instance overrides use the `messages` prop.
8. **Styling is CSS custom properties**, all prefixed `--oge-`, identical to
   the Angular packages — the two render layers share one stylesheet. Never
   target internal class names; override the token.
9. **Slots are props that take nodes**, not children with directives:
   `icon={<SaveIcon />}`. Free `children` render inside the button after the
   label.
10. **Server components:** every component is a client component
    (`'use client'` is already in the package). Import them from a client
    component, or mark your own file `'use client'`.

### Theming

```css
:root {
  --oge-accent: #4f46e5;   /* selection, focus, primary actions */
  --oge-radius-lg: 10px;
}
```

The theme stylesheets are shared with the Angular packages and ship in
`@oge-ui/core` (installed with every package; add it directly under pnpm):
`@oge-ui/core/themes/dark.css` (then `class="oge-theme-dark"` or
`data-oge-theme="dark"` on `<html>` or any subtree; `"auto"` follows
`prefers-color-scheme`), plus the `tailwind.css` and `bootstrap.css`
bridges.

## Common mistakes

Predictable wrong guesses, and what to write instead.

| Wrong | Right |
| --- | --- |
| `import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/buttons'` | `from '@oge-ui/react-buttons'` — the unprefixed package is Angular |
| `imports: [OgeButton]` | nothing — just render `<OgeButton />` |
| `[text]="label"` / `[(loading)]="busy"` | `text={label}` / `loading={busy} onLoadingChange={setBusy}` |
| `(clicked)="save()"` | `onClick={save}` |
| `onClick={(e) => e.cancel = true}` | there is no cancelable pre-event on the React buttons |
| `severity={OgeButtonSeverity.Danger}` | `severity="danger"` |
| forgetting the stylesheet | `import '@oge-ui/react-buttons/styles.css'` once at the app entry |
| `<OgeButton icon="save" />` | `icon={<SaveIcon />}` — slots take nodes |
| `::part` / overriding `.oge-button-native` | override a `--oge-*` token |
| rendering it from a server component | mark the file `'use client'` |

## API reference

### <OgeScheduler>

#### Properties

_Data_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataSource` | `readonly T[] \| DataSource<T> \| OgeSchedulerDataSource<T> \| null` | `null` | Appointment items: a plain array (copied into an internal working set — the prop is never mutated), any `@oge-ui/core` `DataSource` (loaded once; with `remoteFiltering` per visible range) or an `OgeSchedulerDataSource` loaded **per visible range**: `load({ startDate, endDate, resources?, signal })` runs for the period on screen, the previous and next periods are prefetched, navigation is debounced (`debounce`, 150 ms), stale requests are aborted through `signal` and every range is cached (`cacheSize`, 12). A visible status line and `aria-busy` show the load. CRUD goes through the source's `insert`/`update`/`remove` when present (the range reloads afterwards). Bound before the first paint. |
| `remoteFiltering` | `boolean` | `false` | Loads a filtering `@oge-ui/core` `DataSource` per visible range: `load()` receives a `filter` on the date fields (appointments overlapping the range, or any recurring series) and the `signal` of the range. |
| `keyExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'id'` | Key field or selector; items without a resolvable key fall back to their index. |
| `textExpr / startDateExpr / endDateExpr / allDayExpr / colorExpr / locationExpr / descriptionExpr / disabledExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'text' / 'startDate' / …` | Field mapping: names (dotted paths reach nested objects) or getter functions. String dates parse as _local_ wall time and write back in the same storage shape. |
| `recurrenceRuleExpr / recurrenceExceptionExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'recurrenceRule' / 'recurrenceException'` | Recurrence fields: rules in the documented RFC 5545 subset expand into occurrence instances in every view; exceptions are comma-separated EXDATE stamps. |
| `reminderExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'reminder'` | Minutes before the start a reminder fires (see `onReminderTriggered`) — **OGE extra** (Outlook parity). |
| `startTimeZoneExpr / endTimeZoneExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'startTimeZone' / 'endTimeZone'` | An appointment’s own IANA zones. A series recurs on its start zone’s clocks (a `DTSTART;TZID=` in the rule wins), so “09:00 New York” stays 09:00 there across DST while the display shifts; the editor shows and saves the dates in these zones with `showTimeZoneEditor`. Unknown names are ignored. |
| `resources` | `readonly OgeSchedulerResource[]` | `[]` | Resource kinds (`{ fieldExpr, items, label?, useColorAsDefault? }`): editor select fields, default appointment colors and timeline rows. |
| `groups` | `readonly string[]` | `[]` | Resource fields grouping the views, outermost first — `['roomId', 'ownerId']` nests owners inside rooms (**multi-level**, nested headers): day/week columns or row blocks, timeline rows with group header rows. Grouped cells prefill every level on create, and drags across columns / rows / blocks reassign them. |
| `groupOrientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical' \| undefined` | `undefined` | How grouped resources lay out: side by side, or stacked — day/week **row blocks** (a group label column, every block a full time grid) and the timeline rows. Unset = horizontal for day/week, vertical for the timelines; a view option’s own `groupOrientation` wins. Horizontal timelines lay the leaves out as blocks of one track. |
| `groupByDate` | `boolean` | `true` | Horizontal day/week grouping is date-major (each day split into its resources — the 1.x layout) or, with `false`, resource-major (each resource’s days side by side, the all-day strip packed per resource). |
| `disabledSlots` | `OgeSchedulerDisabledSlots \| null` | `null` | Non-bookable slots — a predicate `(date, resources) => boolean` or a list of `{ startDate, endDate, resources?, recurrenceRule?, text? }` ranges (lunch every weekday, a room under maintenance). Rendered **hatched** with `aria-disabled` and an "unavailable" suffix; create, move, resize, paste and drop are refused there and announced. |
| `recurrenceEditMode` | `'dialog' \| 'occurrence' \| 'series'` | `'dialog'` | How edits to a recurring occurrence apply: ask per action, always detach the occurrence (EXDATE + standalone copy), or always change the series. |

_Date & views_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `currentDate` | `Date` | `—` | Anchor date of the visible period — controlled when given, with `onCurrentDateChange`; `defaultCurrentDate` (today when omitted) seeds the uncontrolled state at mount. Writes clamp into `[min, max]`. |
| `defaultCurrentDate` | `Date` | `new Date()` | Uncontrolled initial anchor date. |
| `timeZone` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | The display zone (IANA, e.g. `'Europe/Istanbul'`); unset = the browser’s. Stored dates stay **instants**: every slot, day boundary (23- and 25-hour DST days, skipped and repeated hours), drag snap, “today” line and recurrence expansion follows this zone’s clocks, computed with `Intl.DateTimeFormat` offsets (core’s `ogeZonedParts` / `ogeFromZoned`) — no time-zone database. Events, `currentDate` writes and item patches carry instants; all-day appointments stay on their calendar days. |
| `showTimeZoneEditor` | `boolean` | `false` | Adds start / end **time-zone pickers** to the appointment editor: the date boxes then show the appointment’s own zones (an empty picker follows the scheduler’s zone), and the typed time is saved in the picked zone. |
| `currentView` | `'day' \| 'week' \| 'workWeek' \| 'month' \| 'agenda' \| 'timelineDay' \| 'timelineWeek' \| 'timelineWorkWeek' \| 'timelineMonth' \| 'timelineYear' \| 'year'` | `—` | The active view — controlled when given, with `onCurrentViewChange`. The month and year timelines run at day scale (one column per day, bars snap to days). |
| `defaultCurrentView` | `OgeSchedulerView` | `'week'` | Uncontrolled initial view. |
| `views` | `readonly (OgeSchedulerView \| OgeSchedulerViewOptions)[]` | `['day', 'week', 'month']` | View-switcher entries; option objects override `name`, `dayStartHour`, `dayEndHour`, `cellDuration` and `groupOrientation` per view, and `intervalCount` makes **custom N-day / N-week / N-month views** (`{ type: 'day', intervalCount: 3, name: '3 days' }`); navigation steps by the whole interval. Entries sharing a type are told apart by the switcher. |
| `showWeekNumbers` | `boolean` | `false` | Week numbers in the month rows and the day/week header corner (`W32`, `W32–33` for a fortnight); the grid label carries the spoken text. |
| `weekNumberRule` | `'iso' \| 'locale'` | `'iso'` | ISO 8601 (Monday-first, 4-day rule) or the locale’s own numbering — the first day of week and `Intl.Locale` minimal days (US: Sunday-first, the week holding January 1st is week 1). |
| `moreMode` | `'popup' \| 'drill'` | `'popup'` | What a month "+N more" does: open a keyboard-accessible **popup list** of the day (Tab-reachable button, focus moves in, Up/Down/Home/End, Enter opens an entry, Escape returns, a "Go to day" action) or drill into the day view. |
| `virtualScrolling` | `boolean \| 'auto'` | `'auto'` | Timeline **row virtualization** for many resources — rows render at fixed heights on core’s offset tree, so the window is exact; `'auto'` turns it on above 50 rows. The axis headers stay sticky. |
| `adaptiveView` | `boolean \| { breakpoint?: number; view?: OgeSchedulerView }` | `false` | Switches the visible view to `view` (agenda) when the scheduler's **own** width — a `ResizeObserver`, never the window — drops below `breakpoint` (600px), and back to the previous view when it grows again. The switch writes `currentView` like a user pick, on crossings only, so the switcher keeps working at any width and a view picked while narrow wins. |
| `min / max` | `Date \| undefined` | `—` | Navigable date bounds: navigation buttons disable at the edges and every date write clamps. |
| `firstDayOfWeek` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | First day of week (0 = Sunday); `undefined` resolves from the locale via `Intl.Locale.weekInfo`. |
| `weekendDays` | `readonly number[] \| undefined` | `—` | Weekend days (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday) the day/week, month and timeline views shade and the `workWeek` view drops. `undefined` resolves from the locale via `Intl.Locale#getWeekInfo()` (Friday + Saturday in `he-IL`), falling back to Saturday + Sunday. |
| `hiddenWeekDays` | `readonly number[] \| undefined` | `—` | Weekdays removed from the week views; the `workWeek` view always drops the weekend on top. |
| `dayStartHour / dayEndHour / cellDuration` | `number` | `0 / 24 / 30` | Visible hour window and slot raster (minutes) of the time grids. |
| `agendaDuration` | `number` | `7` | Days the agenda view lists from the anchor date. |
| `scrollTime` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Initial scroll position of the day/week body in hours (fractions allowed, e.g. `8.5`); applied at mount and re-applied on view/period changes. |
| `rtlEnabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | `undefined` | Right-to-left layout: day columns, month cells and the timeline run right-to-left (the first day is the rightmost column), the toolbar chevrons flip, Left/Right (and Ctrl+Left/Right moves) mirror and horizontal drag deltas invert. Unset follows the page — `ogeResolveDirection` reads the computed `direction` or the nearest `dir` attribute after the first render and observes later `dir` changes; an explicit value also sets `dir` on the host. |

_Behavior_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowAdding / allowUpdating / allowDeleting / allowDragging / allowResizing` | `boolean` | `true` | Per-capability editing gates. |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | **Display-only shorthand**: overrides every `allow*` flag at once and hides the editing affordances. The day/week and month grids then carry `aria-readonly="true"` (also when every `allow*` flag is off). |
| `snapDuration` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Drag/resize snap raster in minutes; defaults to `cellDuration`. |
| `workHours` | `OgeSchedulerWorkHours \| null` | `null` | Working-hours emphasis: cells outside `{ start, end, days? }` get the off-hours shading. A resource item’s own `workHours` / `workDays` win for its grouped columns, rows and blocks (the innermost level that sets them). |
| `snapToWorkHours` | `boolean` | `false` | Clamps timed moves, drag-to-create ranges and drops into the target’s working hours (keeping the length when it fits). |
| `allowOverlap` | `boolean` | `true` | `false` refuses a create / move / resize / paste / drop that overlaps another appointment — on the same resource when grouped, recurring series expanded; the change is cancelled with a visible notice and an announcement. |
| `conflictCheck` | `(appointment: T, conflicts: readonly OgeSchedulerAppointment<T>[]) => boolean` | `—` | Decides overlapping changes: return `true` to let one land. Wins over `allowOverlap`. |
| `selectedAppointments` | `readonly T[]` | `—` | The selected items — controlled when given, with `onSelectedAppointmentsChange`: Ctrl/⌘-click toggles, Shift-click extends over the chip order, a plain click replaces; Ctrl+Space / Shift+Space from the keyboard. Selected chips get an accent ring and a "selected" suffix; Ctrl+C copies the selection. |
| `defaultSelectedAppointments` | `readonly T[]` | `[]` | Uncontrolled initial selection. |
| `undoLimit` | `number` | `50` | Undo steps kept for Ctrl/⌘+Z and Ctrl/⌘+Y (Ctrl/⌘+Shift+Z). One user action — a move, a paste, a detached occurrence — is one step; an undo replays through the normal cancelable pipelines. `0` turns undo off. |
| `showAddButton` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the toolbar "new appointment" button (Outlook parity) — creation without double-click; hidden while `readOnly` or `allowAdding={false}`. |
| `showAllDayPanel` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the all-day strip in the day/week views. |
| `showCurrentTimeIndicator` | `boolean` | `true` | The accent now-line in today's column. |
| `shadeUntilCurrentTime` | `boolean` | `false` | Dims today's column above the now-line. |
| `maxAppointmentsPerCell` | `number \| 'auto'` | `'auto'` | Month-view lane budget per cell; the overflow folds into a "+N more" button (see `moreMode`). |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | BCP 47 locale for every `Intl` format; defaults to the browser locale. |
| `messages` | `Partial<OgeSchedulerMessages>` | `—` | Per-instance message overrides, merged over `<OgeSchedulerConfigProvider>` per top-level block. |
| `dateNavigatorText` | `(start: Date, end: Date, view: OgeSchedulerView) => string` | `—` | Custom period-title formatter for the toolbar. |
| `renderAppointment` | `(context: OgeAppointmentRenderContext<T>) => ReactNode` | `—` | Replaces the chip content — the React face of `*ogeAppointmentTemplate`. Context: `appointment` and `view`; the colored surface, gestures and keyboard semantics stay with the component. |
| `renderCell` | `(context: OgeSchedulerCellRenderContext) => ReactNode` | `—` | **OGE extra** — rendered inside every empty grid cell; the React face of `ogeCellTemplate`. Context: `date`, `view`, `allDay`. |
| `renderDateHeader` | `(context: OgeDateHeaderRenderContext) => ReactNode` | `—` | **OGE extra** — replaces the day/week date headers; the React face of `ogeDateHeaderTemplate`. Context: `date`, `view`. |
| `renderResourceHeader` | `(context: OgeResourceHeaderRenderContext) => ReactNode` | `—` | Replaces the grouped resource headers (day/week column headers, vertical group labels, timeline row heads and group rows); the React face of `ogeResourceHeaderTemplate`. Context: `item`, `resource`, `level`, `view`. |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Applied to the `.oge-scheduler` host. |

#### Methods

_Imperative handle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addAppointment(appointmentData)` | `void` | Inserts programmatically through the same cancelable `onAppointmentAdding` pipeline as interactive creation. |
| `updateAppointment(appointmentData, patch)` | `void` | Applies a patch through the guarded update pipeline. |
| `deleteAppointment(appointmentData)` | `void` | Deletes through the guarded delete pipeline. |
| `showAppointmentPopup(appointmentData?, createNew?)` | `void` | Opens the editing form — prefilled create form with `createNew`/no data, edit form otherwise (dx parity: the method opens the _form_). |
| `hideAppointmentPopup()` | `void` | Closes the editor dialog and the summary popup. |
| `scrollToTime(hours, minutes?)` | `void` | Scrolls the day/week body to the given time of day. |
| `scrollTo(date)` | `void` | Navigates to `date` and scrolls to its time of day. |
| `getStartViewDate() / getEndViewDate()` | `Date` | First moment / exclusive end of the visible period, as instants (with `timeZone`, the zone’s midnights — a DST day is 23 or 25 hours long). |
| `getDataSource()` | `readonly T[] \| DataSource<T> \| OgeSchedulerDataSource<T> \| null` | The bound data source, as given. |
| `reload()` | `void` | Reloads the data source: a load-once `DataSource` loads again, a range source drops its cache and reloads the visible range. |
| `focus()` | `void` | Focuses the active view's grid (roving cell). |
| `goToday() / navigate(direction)` | `void` | Toolbar equivalents: jump to today / step one period (respects `min`/`max`). |
| `copyAppointments(appointment?) / pasteAppointments(target)` | `number` | The clipboard (what Ctrl+C on a chip and Ctrl+V on a cell do): copies the selection — or `appointment` when it is not part of it — and pastes so the earliest copy starts at `target.date` (`{ date, allDay, values }`), keys dropped, a grouped target’s resources applied, each copy through the guarded insert pipeline, all as one undo step. Return the count. |
| `clearSelection()` | `void` | Empties the selection. |
| `undo() / redo()` | `boolean` | Reverts / re-applies the last scheduler edit (the Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y keys); `false` when there is none. |
| `canUndo() / canRedo()` | `boolean` | Whether a step is available (as of the last render). |
| `getExportData(range?)` | `OgeSchedulerExportData<T>` | The export model the `/export-*` entries read: every appointment (series unexpanded) plus the expanded, chronological rows of `range` — the visible period by default. |
| `print(options?)` | `Promise<void>` | Prints the current view: the scheduler cloned with the page’s stylesheets into a hidden frame (scroll areas expanded), then the browser’s print dialog. |

_Import / export (lazy secondary entries)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `exportToICalendar(scheduler, options?) / importICalendar(scheduler, text, options?)` | `@oge-ui/react-scheduler/export-ical` | **No dependencies** — RFC 5545 `.ics` export from the ref handle (downloads unless `download: false`, returns the text): one `VEVENT` per appointment with `UID`, `DTSTAMP`, `DTSTART`/`DTEND` (`VALUE=DATE` + exclusive end for all-day), `RRULE`, `RDATE`, `EXDATE`, TEXT escaping and 75-octet folding. The import reads `DURATION`, UTC values, `RECURRENCE-ID` overrides (folded into the series as EXDATE + a standalone item) and maps every event through the `*Expr` field names into `addAppointment`. Floating local time — time zones are a later release. |
| `exportSchedulerToPdf(scheduler, options?) / buildSchedulerPdfDocument(data, options?)` | `@oge-ui/react-scheduler/export-pdf` | Lazy PDF list export (`jspdf` peer): the period’s appointments grouped by day (time, subject, location, resources), paginated with the header repeated. Text outside WinAnsi needs a Unicode TrueType `font` — per export, or once via `setOgePdfDefaultFont()` from `@oge-ui/behavior`. |
| `exportSchedulerToExcel(scheduler, options?) / buildSchedulerExcelWorkbook(data, options?)` | `@oge-ui/react-scheduler/export-excel` | Lazy Excel list export (`exceljs` peer): one row per appointment / occurrence with typed Date cells, all-day and recurring columns and one column per resource kind. |

#### Events

_Editing (cancelable pipeline)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onAppointmentAdding / onAppointmentUpdating / onAppointmentDeleting` | `(event: OgeSchedulerAppointment*ingEvent<T>) => void` | Cancelable pre-events — set `event.cancel = true` to veto before the store changes. |
| `onAppointmentAdded / onAppointmentUpdated / onAppointmentDeleted` | `(event: OgeSchedulerAppointment*edEvent<T>) => void` | Fired only for applied changes — persist from these when binding plain arrays. |
| `onEditorShowing` | `(event: OgeSchedulerEditorShowingEvent<T>) => void` | Cancelable, before the editor opens; replace `formItems` (`<OgeForm>` item definitions, render props included) to customize the form (dx `onAppointmentFormOpening` parity). |

_Reminders_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onReminderTriggered` | `(event: OgeSchedulerReminderEvent<T>) => void` | Fires once per occurrence when `start − reminder` minutes is reached (checked about every 30 s while mounted) — **OGE extra**. |

_Interaction_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onAppointmentClick / onAppointmentDblClick` | `(event: OgeSchedulerAppointmentClickEvent<T>) => void` | Chip clicks; single click also opens the popup, double click the editor. |
| `onCellClick / onCellDblClick` | `(event: OgeSchedulerCellClickEvent) => void` | Empty-cell clicks; double click also opens the prefilled create editor. |
| `onAppointmentContextMenu / onCellContextMenu` | `(event: OgeSchedulerAppointmentClickEvent<T> \| OgeSchedulerCellClickEvent) => void` | Right-clicks with full payloads. A **built-in context menu** also opens (chip: edit/delete through the guarded pipelines incl. recurrence scope; cell: new appointment prefilled at that slot — labels in `messages.menu`); listen to these to add your own entries alongside it. |
| `onRangeSelected` | `(event: OgeSchedulerRangeSelectedEvent) => void` | A drag-to-create cell-range selection landed; the prefilled create editor opens next. |
| `onAppointmentDropped` | `(event: OgeSchedulerAppointmentDroppedEvent<T>) => void` | A `useOgeSchedulerDraggable` item — or another scheduler’s appointment — was dropped in (pointer, touch, or the keyboard twin); the built item went through `onAppointmentAdding`. Payload: `itemData`, `appointmentData`, `startDate`/`endDate`/`allDay`, the slot’s `resources` and `added`. |
| `onDragOut` | `(event: OgeSchedulerDragOutEvent<T>) => void` | An appointment was dragged out of the scheduler and released: `appointment`, `appointmentData`, the pointer, the `target` under it and `droppedOnScheduler` (another scheduler added a copy) — the app decides whether to remove it here. |
| `onCurrentDateChange / onCurrentViewChange / onSelectedAppointmentsChange` | `(value: Date) => void / (value: OgeSchedulerView) => void / (items: readonly T[]) => void` | The controlled halves of `currentDate` / `currentView` / `selectedAppointments`; they also report uncontrolled changes. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeSchedulerAppointment<T>` | `interface` | The normalized appointment: `key`, `source` (the original item), `text`, `startDate`/`endDate`, `allDay`, `color`, `description`, recurrence fields and `disabled`. |
| `OgeSchedulerViewOptions` | `interface` | Per-view overrides: `type`, `name`, `dayStartHour`, `dayEndHour`, `cellDuration`, `intervalCount`, `groupOrientation`. |
| `OgeSchedulerWorkHours` | `interface` | `{ start, end, days? }` — the emphasized working hours. |
| `OgeSchedulerResourceItem` | `interface` | `{ id, text, color?, workHours?, workDays? }` — one assignable resource; its own working hours shade its grouped columns / rows. |
| `OgeSchedulerDisabledSlots / OgeSchedulerBlockedRange` | `type / interface` | A predicate `(date, resources) => boolean` or a list of `{ startDate, endDate, resources?, recurrenceRule?, text? }` — `resources` limits a range to `{ field: id \| id[] }`. |
| `OgeSchedulerConflictCheck<T>` | `type` | `(appointment, conflicts) => boolean` — `true` lets an overlapping change land. |
| `OgeSchedulerAppointmentDroppedEvent<T> / OgeSchedulerDragOutEvent<T>` | `interface` | The drag-in / drag-out payloads (see the events). |
| `OgeSchedulerDataSource<T> / OgeSchedulerLoadOptions` | `interface` | `{ load(options), insert?, update?, remove?, debounce?, prefetch?, cacheSize? }` — the range source; `load` receives `{ startDate, endDate, resources?, signal }` (instants, `resources` = the grouped ids on screen) and resolves to the items overlapping the range (series included). |
| `ogeZonedParts / ogeFromZoned / ogeTzOffset / ogeToWallClock / ogeFromWallClock` | `function (@oge-ui/core)` | The zoned date math the scheduler and the Gantt share: an instant’s fields on a zone’s clocks, the instant of a wall time (skipped times move forward, repeated ones take the earlier side unless `disambiguation` says otherwise), the offset in minutes, and the wall-clock frame conversions — all `Intl`, DST-exact. |
| `OgeSchedulerExportData<T>` | `interface` | `{ title, rangeStart, rangeEnd, locale, rows, appointments, fields, resources, messages }` — what `getExportData()` returns and the export builders read. |
| `OgeResourceHeaderRenderContext` | `interface` | `{ item, resource, level, view }` — what `renderResourceHeader` receives. |
| `OgeAppointmentRenderContext<T>` | `interface` | `{ appointment, view }` — what `renderAppointment` receives. |
| `OgeSchedulerCellRenderContext` | `interface` | `{ date, view, allDay }` — what `renderCell` receives. |
| `OgeDateHeaderRenderContext` | `interface` | `{ date, view }` — what `renderDateHeader` receives. |
| `OgeSchedulerHandle<T>` | `interface` | The `ref` surface — every method in the table above. |

### useOgeSchedulerDraggable

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `unknown` | The item a drop turns into an appointment — its fields are kept and start / end / all-day plus the slot’s resources are written through the target scheduler’s `*Expr` field names. Spread the returned props on the element: it becomes a `role="button"` tab stop. |
| `duration` | `number \| undefined` | Appointment length in minutes; omitted = the target’s cell duration (whole days on day-scale targets). |
| `text` | `string \| undefined` | The label announced on pick-up; defaults to the element’s text. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Gestures` | `pointer · touch · keyboard` | Pointer and touch run the shared drag-drop gesture (ghost preview, 300 ms touch hold, Escape cancels) with a live drop preview in the target; the **keyboard / single-pointer twin**: Enter, Space or a click picks the item up (`aria-pressed`, announced) and Enter or a click on any scheduler cell places it — Escape puts it down. |

### Configuration

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeSchedulerConfigProvider` | `(props: { config?: OgeSchedulerConfigInput; children?: ReactNode }) => JSX.Element` | `—` | Configures every scheduler below the provider — the React counterpart of Angular’s `provideOgeSchedulerConfig()`; shallow merge per top-level key (a partial `messages` replaces whole nested blocks). Nested providers merge over the outer one, and a new `config` object re-resolves the subtree (switch the UI language at runtime). |
| `useOgeSchedulerConfig()` | `() => OgeSchedulerConfig` | `—` | Reads the resolved config of the current subtree. |
| `messages` | `OgeSchedulerMessages` | `—` | Every user-facing string, aria labels included: `toolbar` (labels, view names, date-navigator), `popup`, `editor` (titles, field labels, validation), `grid` (aria templates with `{token}` placeholders, "+{count} more") and `announcements` (live-region templates). Single-sourced in `@oge-ui/scheduler-engine`, shared with the Angular scheduler. |
| `minAppointmentMinutes` | `number` | `15` | Minimum rendered chip height in minutes — zero-length reminders stay clickable. |

## Demos

Each demo below is a complete standalone component — copy one whole and it compiles.

### iCalendar

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';
import type { OgeSchedulerHandle } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

// /export-ical has no dependencies: series stay series (RRULE, RDATE,
// EXDATE), all-day events use VALUE=DATE, and the import folds moved
// occurrences (RECURRENCE-ID) back into their series.
type Appt = Record<string, unknown>;

const appointments: Appt[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    text: 'Weekly sync',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 3, 10, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 3, 11, 0),
    recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO',
  },
];

export function CalendarFiles() {
  const scheduler = useRef<OgeSchedulerHandle<Appt>>(null);

  const exportIcs = async () => {
    const { exportToICalendar } = await import('@oge-ui/react-scheduler/export-ical');
    if (scheduler.current) {
      exportToICalendar(scheduler.current, { filename: 'team.ics', calendarName: 'Team' });
    }
  };

  const importIcs = async () => {
    const { importICalendar } = await import('@oge-ui/react-scheduler/export-ical');
    // a file input would pass await file.text() here
    const text = await fetch('/team.ics').then((response) => response.text());
    if (scheduler.current) importICalendar(scheduler.current, text, { uidField: 'uid' });
  };
  return (
    <>
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <button type="button" onClick={exportIcs}>Download .ics</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={importIcs}>Import sample .ics</button>
      </div>
      <OgeScheduler
        ref={scheduler}
        dataSource={appointments}
        defaultCurrentDate={new Date(2026, 7, 6)}
        defaultCurrentView="month"
        views={['week', 'month', 'agenda']}
        style={{ height: 560 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### PDF, Excel & print

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';
import type { OgeSchedulerHandle } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

// PDF and Excel are lazy entries (jspdf / exceljs peers) exporting the
// visible period as a chronological list; print() prints the view itself.
type Appt = Record<string, unknown>;

const appointments: Appt[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    text: 'Design pairing',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 10, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 12, 0),
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    text: 'Customer visit',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 4),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6),
    allDay: true,
  },
];

export function ListExports() {
  const scheduler = useRef<OgeSchedulerHandle<Appt>>(null);

  const exportPdf = async () => {
    const { exportSchedulerToPdf } = await import('@oge-ui/react-scheduler/export-pdf');
    // text outside WinAnsi needs a Unicode font: setOgePdfDefaultFont() from @oge-ui/behavior
    if (scheduler.current) await exportSchedulerToPdf(scheduler.current, { filename: 'week.pdf' });
  };

  const exportExcel = async () => {
    const { exportSchedulerToExcel } = await import('@oge-ui/react-scheduler/export-excel');
    if (scheduler.current) await exportSchedulerToExcel(scheduler.current, { filename: 'week.xlsx' });
  };
  return (
    <>
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <button type="button" onClick={exportPdf}>PDF</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={exportExcel}>Excel</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => scheduler.current?.print({ title: 'Team week' })}>
          Print
        </button>
      </div>
      <OgeScheduler
        ref={scheduler}
        dataSource={appointments}
        defaultCurrentDate={new Date(2026, 7, 6)}
        defaultCurrentView="week"
        dayStartHour={8}
        dayEndHour={18}
        style={{ height: 560 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Getting started

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';
import type { OgeSchedulerView } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

const appointments = [
  {
    id: 1,
    text: 'Design review',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 4, 9, 30),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 4, 11, 0),
    color: '#2563eb',
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    text: 'Sprint planning',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 10, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 12, 0),
    color: '#16a34a',
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    text: 'Customer workshop',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 5),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 7),
    allDay: true,
    color: '#d97706',
  },
];

export function TeamCalendar() {
  const [date, setDate] = useState(new Date(2026, 7, 6));
  const [view, setView] = useState<OgeSchedulerView>('week');
  return (
    // One element, a working scheduler: week view with an all-day strip,
    // drag-move / edge-resize (Escape cancels mid-gesture), double-click or
    // Enter creates through the form dialog, single click opens the summary
    // popup. Dates are plain local Dates — no date library, no adapter.
    <OgeScheduler
      dataSource={appointments}
      currentDate={date}
      onCurrentDateChange={setDate}
      currentView={view}
      onCurrentViewChange={setView}
      dayStartHour={8}
      dayEndHour={19}
      style={{ height: 640 }}
    />
  );
}
```

### Field mapping

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

const meetings = [
  {
    meetingId: 'a',
    subject: 'Standup',
    slot: { begin: '2026-08-06T09:00', finish: '2026-08-06T09:15' },
    badge: '#7c3aed',
  },
  {
    meetingId: 'b',
    subject: '1:1',
    slot: { begin: '2026-08-06T09:00', finish: '2026-08-06T10:00' },
    badge: '#0891b2',
  },
];

export function MappedMeetings() {
  return (
    // Any item shape binds through the *Expr props (field names, dotted
    // paths or getter functions). String dates parse as LOCAL wall time and
    // write back in the SAME storage shape — a string-dated store never
    // silently turns into Date objects after an edit.
    <OgeScheduler
      dataSource={meetings}
      keyExpr="meetingId"
      textExpr="subject"
      startDateExpr="slot.begin"
      endDateExpr="slot.finish"
      colorExpr="badge"
      defaultCurrentDate={new Date(2026, 7, 6)}
      dayStartHour={8}
      dayEndHour={18}
      style={{ height: 560 }}
    />
  );
}
```

### Editing pipeline

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';
import type { OgeSchedulerAppointmentAddingEvent, OgeSchedulerAppointmentDeletingEvent } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

const appointments = [
  {
    id: 1,
    text: 'Release',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 7, 14, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 7, 15, 0),
  },
];

function blockWeekends(
  event: OgeSchedulerAppointmentAddingEvent<Record<string, unknown>>,
): void {
  const day = (event.appointmentData['startDate'] as Date).getDay();
  if (day === 0 || day === 6) event.cancel = true;
}

function confirmDelete(
  event: OgeSchedulerAppointmentDeletingEvent<Record<string, unknown>>,
): void {
  event.cancel = !confirm('Delete this appointment?');
}

export function GuardedScheduler() {
  return (
    // Every mutation runs a cancelable '-ing' callback before the store
    // changes; set cancel = true to veto (weekends here). The matching
    // past-tense callback fires only for applied changes — persist from there.
    // allowAdding/Updating/Deleting/Dragging/Resizing gate each capability.
    <OgeScheduler
      dataSource={appointments}
      defaultCurrentDate={new Date(2026, 7, 6)}
      dayStartHour={8}
      dayEndHour={18}
      allowResizing={false}
      onAppointmentAdding={blockWeekends}
      onAppointmentDeleting={confirmDelete}
      style={{ height: 560 }}
    />
  );
}
```

### Planner ergonomics

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

const appointments = [
  {
    id: 1,
    text: 'Architecture sync',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 9, 30),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 10, 30),
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    text: 'Late incident review',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 18, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 19, 0),
    color: '#dc2626',
  },
];

export function PlannerWeek() {
  return (
    // Planner ergonomics in one place: the workWeek view drops the weekend,
    // workHours shades off-hours cells, shadeUntilCurrentTime dims the elapsed
    // part of today, scrollTime opens the grid at 08:00 instead of midnight,
    // min/max clamp navigation (prev/next disable at the bounds), and
    // snapDuration makes drag/resize snap at 15 minutes on a 30-minute raster.
    // Drag over empty cells to select a range — the create dialog opens
    // prefilled (onRangeSelected fires first). readOnly turns it all off.
    <OgeScheduler
      dataSource={appointments}
      defaultCurrentDate={new Date(2026, 7, 6)}
      defaultCurrentView="workWeek"
      views={['day', 'workWeek', 'week', 'month']}
      scrollTime={8}
      workHours={{ start: 9, end: 17 }}
      shadeUntilCurrentTime
      snapDuration={15}
      min={new Date(2026, 6, 1)}
      max={new Date(2026, 8, 30)}
      style={{ height: 640 }}
    />
  );
}
```

### Teams, recurrence & timeline

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';
import type { OgeSchedulerResource } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

const resources: OgeSchedulerResource[] = [
  {
    fieldExpr: 'ownerId',
    label: 'Owner',
    useColorAsDefault: true,
    items: [
      { id: 'ada', text: 'Ada', color: '#7c3aed' },
      { id: 'grace', text: 'Grace', color: '#0891b2' },
    ],
  },
];

const appointments = [
  {
    id: 1,
    text: 'Daily standup',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 3, 9, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 3, 9, 15),
    recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=DAILY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR',
    ownerId: 'ada',
    reminder: 5,
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    text: 'Design pairing',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 5, 14, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 5, 16, 0),
    ownerId: 'grace',
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    text: 'Ops review',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 11, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 12, 0),
  },
];

export function TeamTimeline() {
  return (
    // Recurring series (RFC 5545 subset) expand into occurrences in every
    // view; editing or deleting one asks "this appointment or the entire
    // series?" (recurrenceEditMode). resources drive the editor's assignment
    // selects, default colors (useColorAsDefault) and the timeline rows
    // (groups). The agenda view lists the coming days; onReminderTriggered
    // fires when a reminder lead time is reached.
    <OgeScheduler
      dataSource={appointments}
      defaultCurrentDate={new Date(2026, 7, 6)}
      defaultCurrentView="timelineWeek"
      views={['week', 'timelineDay', 'timelineWeek', 'agenda', 'month']}
      resources={resources}
      groups={['ownerId']}
      dayStartHour={8}
      dayEndHour={18}
      style={{ height: 560 }}
    />
  );
}
```

### Appointment template

```ts
'use client';

const appointments = [

export function TemplatedDay() {
  return (
    // renderAppointment replaces the chip content; the colored surface,
    // drag/resize handles and keyboard semantics stay with the component.
    // renderCell / renderDateHeader exist too.

      dataSource={appointments}

    />
  );
}
```

### Configuration & i18n

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeScheduler, OgeSchedulerConfigProvider } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

// Typically once near the app root — shown per-component here. The merge
// is shallow per top-level key: replace whole nested blocks, not single
// strings. A messages prop on one instance overrides the provider the same
// way, and a new config object re-resolves the subtree at runtime.
const config = {
  messages: {
    toolbar: {
      label: 'Terminplaner',
      today: 'Heute',
      previous: 'Zurück',
      next: 'Weiter',

        timelineWeek: 'Zeitachse Woche',
```

### Rule patterns

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

// The editor reads and writes these RRULEs in full: the nth / last
// weekday (BYSETPOS), several days of the month, a yearly month + weekday,
// COUNT or UNTIL. Rules it cannot express are kept verbatim; a live summary
// ("Every month on the second Tuesday") reads the rule back. Double-click a
// chip to open the editor.
const appointments = [
  {
    id: 'second-tuesday',
    text: 'Patch Tuesday (2nd Tue)',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 11, 10, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 11, 11, 0),
    recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=TU;BYSETPOS=2',
  },
  {
    id: 'payroll',
    text: 'Payroll run',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 1, 9, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 1, 9, 30),
    recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=1,15',
  },
  {
    id: 'last-workday',
    text: 'Month close (last workday)',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 31, 16, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 31, 17, 0),
    recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1',
  },
  {
    id: 'course',
    text: 'Onboarding course',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 3, 14, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 3, 15, 0),
    recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE;COUNT=6',
  },
];

export function RecurringPatterns() {
  return (
    <OgeScheduler
      dataSource={appointments}
      defaultCurrentDate={new Date(2026, 7, 6)}
      defaultCurrentView="month"
      views={['week', 'month', 'agenda']}
      style={{ height: 640 }}
    />
  );
}
```

### Exceptions

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

// recurrenceException lists skipped occurrences (EXDATE stamps). The
// editor shows them as removable chips and adds new ones from a date picker;
// deleting a single occurrence from the popup adds one too.
const appointments = [
  {
    id: 'standup',
    text: 'Standup (skips the 12th)',

    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 3, 9, 15),
    recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=DAILY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;UNTIL=20260828T235959',
    recurrenceException: '20260812T090000',
  },

  return (
    <OgeScheduler
      dataSource={appointments}
      defaultCurrentDate={new Date(2026, 7, 12)}

      dayStartHour={8}
      dayEndHour={12}
      recurrenceEditMode="dialog"
```

### Range loading

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';
import type { OgeSchedulerDataSource, OgeSchedulerHandle } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

// load() runs per visible range: the neighbours are prefetched, navigation
// is debounced, a range the user navigated away from is aborted through
// signal, and every range is cached. Edits go through insert / update /
// remove, then the range reloads.
type Appt = Record<string, unknown>;

// module scope: one source for the component's lifetime (a new object
// would rebind and reload)
const source: OgeSchedulerDataSource<Appt> = {
  debounce: 200,
  load: async ({ startDate, endDate, signal }) => {
    const query = new URLSearchParams({
      from: startDate.toISOString(),
      to: endDate.toISOString(),
    });
    // the server returns every appointment overlapping the range, recurring
    // series included; the scheduler expands occurrences client-side
    const response = await fetch('/api/appointments?' + query.toString(), { signal });
    const rows: { id: number; text: string; start: string; end: string }[] =
      await response.json();
    return rows.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      text: row.text,
      startDate: new Date(row.start),
      endDate: new Date(row.end),
    }));
  },
  insert: (item) =>
    fetch('/api/appointments', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(item) }),
  update: (key, patch) =>
    fetch('/api/appointments/' + String(key), {
      method: 'PATCH',
      body: JSON.stringify(patch),
    }),
  remove: (key) => fetch('/api/appointments/' + String(key), { method: 'DELETE' }),
};

export function RemoteCalendar() {
  const scheduler = useRef<OgeSchedulerHandle<Appt>>(null);
  return (
    <>
      <div className="mb-3 flex gap-2">
        <button type="button" onClick={() => scheduler.current?.reload()}>
          Reload
        </button>
      </div>
      <OgeScheduler
        ref={scheduler}
        dataSource={source}
        defaultCurrentDate={new Date(2026, 2, 4)}
        defaultCurrentView="week"
        dayStartHour={8}
        dayEndHour={18}
        style={{ height: 560 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Conflicts

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';
import type { OgeSchedulerAppointment } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

// allowOverlap={false} refuses overlapping changes with a notice and an
// announcement; conflictCheck decides case by case and wins — here a change
// may overlap tentative holds, never a confirmed appointment.
type Appt = Record<string, unknown>;

const appointments: Appt[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    text: 'Surgery block',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 9, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 12, 0),
    color: '#dc2626',
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    text: 'Hold — maybe lunch',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 12, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 13, 30),
    color: '#94a3b8',
    tentative: true,
  },
];

const onlyTentative = (
  _appointment: Appt,
  conflicts: readonly OgeSchedulerAppointment<Appt>[],
): boolean => conflicts.every((c) => c.source['tentative'] === true);

export function OperatingRoom() {
  return (
    <OgeScheduler
      dataSource={appointments}
      defaultCurrentDate={new Date(2026, 7, 6)}
      defaultCurrentView="day"
      allowOverlap={false}
      conflictCheck={onlyTentative}
      dayStartHour={8}
      dayEndHour={18}
      style={{ height: 560 }}
    />
  );
}
```

### Drag in from outside

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeScheduler, useOgeSchedulerDraggable } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';
import type { OgeSchedulerAppointmentDroppedEvent } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

// useOgeSchedulerDraggable turns any element into an appointment source:
// drag it onto a slot, or press Enter / click to pick it up and Enter / click
// a cell to place it (the keyboard and single-pointer twin).
// onAppointmentDropped reports the built item; onDragOut fires when a chip
// is dragged out and released elsewhere.
interface Task {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  minutes: number;
}

const backlog: Task[] = [
  { id: 't1', text: 'Write release notes', minutes: 60 },
  { id: 't2', text: 'Review pull requests', minutes: 90 },
  { id: 't3', text: 'Prepare demo', minutes: 120 },
];

function TaskChip({ task }: { task: Task }) {
  const drag = useOgeSchedulerDraggable({ data: task, duration: task.minutes });
  return (
    <li {...drag} className={drag.className + ' rounded border px-3 py-1 text-sm'}>
      {task.text} · {task.minutes} min
    </li>
  );
}

export function Backlog() {
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState(backlog);
  const [lastAction, setLastAction] = useState('');
  const [appointments] = useState<Record<string, unknown>[]>([]);

  const dropped = (event: OgeSchedulerAppointmentDroppedEvent<Record<string, unknown>>) => {
    if (!event.added) return;
    const task = event.itemData as Task;
    setTasks((list) => list.filter((t) => t.id !== task.id));
    setLastAction('Scheduled ' + task.text);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <ul className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {tasks.map((task) => (
          <TaskChip key={task.id} task={task} />
        ))}
      </ul>
      <OgeScheduler
        dataSource={appointments}
        defaultCurrentDate={new Date(2026, 7, 6)}
        defaultCurrentView="week"
        dayStartHour={8}
        dayEndHour={18}
        onAppointmentDropped={dropped}
        onDragOut={(event) => setLastAction('Dragged out: ' + event.appointment.text)}
        style={{ height: 560 }}
      />
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm" aria-live="polite">{lastAction}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Selection, clipboard & undo

```ts
'use client';

import { useReducer, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';
import type { OgeSchedulerHandle } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

// Ctrl/⌘-click toggles chips into the selection, Shift-click extends it;
// Ctrl+C copies, Ctrl+V on a focused cell pastes, Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and
// redo every edit. The same actions are methods on the ref handle.
type Appt = Record<string, unknown>;

const appointments: Appt[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    text: 'Design pairing',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 10, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 12, 0),
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    text: 'Release prep',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 13, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 15, 30),
    color: '#16a34a',
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    text: 'Interviews',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 7, 14, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 7, 16, 0),
    color: '#d97706',
  },
];

export function SelectAndUndo() {
  const scheduler = useRef<OgeSchedulerHandle<Appt>>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<readonly Appt[]>([]);
  // canUndo() / canRedo() read the history as of the last render
  const [, refresh] = useReducer((n: number) => n + 1, 0);
  return (
    <>
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => { scheduler.current?.undo(); refresh(); }}
          disabled={!scheduler.current?.canUndo()}
        >
          Undo
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => { scheduler.current?.redo(); refresh(); }}
          disabled={!scheduler.current?.canRedo()}
        >
          Redo
        </button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => scheduler.current?.clearSelection()}>
          Clear selection
        </button>
        <span className="text-sm">{selected.length} selected</span>
      </div>
      <OgeScheduler
        ref={scheduler}
        dataSource={appointments}
        defaultCurrentDate={new Date(2026, 7, 6)}
        defaultCurrentView="week"
        selectedAppointments={selected}
        onSelectedAppointmentsChange={setSelected}
        onAppointmentAdded={refresh}
        onAppointmentUpdated={refresh}
        onAppointmentDeleted={refresh}
        undoLimit={100}
        dayStartHour={8}
        dayEndHour={18}
        style={{ height: 560 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Display zone

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

// Stored dates are instants; timeZone picks the clocks the views show.
// Each meeting keeps its own zone (startTimeZone): a series recurs on that
// zone's clocks, and the editor shows the zone pickers.
const zones = [
  { value: '', text: 'Browser zone' },
  { value: 'America/New_York', text: 'New York' },
  { value: 'Europe/Istanbul', text: 'Istanbul' },
  { value: 'Asia/Kathmandu', text: 'Kathmandu (UTC+5:45)' },
  { value: 'Australia/Lord_Howe', text: 'Lord Howe (half-hour DST)' },
];

const appointments = [
  {
    id: 1,
    text: 'New York standup',
    startDate: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 2, 2, 14, 0)), // 09:00 EST
    endDate: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 2, 2, 14, 30)),
    recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=DAILY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR',
    startTimeZone: 'America/New_York',
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    text: 'Kathmandu support sync',
    startDate: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 2, 4, 12, 15)), // 18:00 NPT
    endDate: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 2, 4, 13, 15)),
    startTimeZone: 'Asia/Kathmandu',
  },
];

export function DistributedTeam() {
  const [zone, setZone] = useState('Europe/Istanbul');
  return (
    <>
      <label className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
        Display zone
        <select value={zone} onChange={(event) => setZone(event.target.value)}>
          {zones.map((option) => (
            <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
              {option.text}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </label>
      <OgeScheduler
        dataSource={appointments}
        defaultCurrentDate={new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 2, 4, 12))}
        defaultCurrentView="week"
        timeZone={zone || undefined}
        showTimeZoneEditor
        scrollTime={7}
        style={{ height: 560 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### DST day

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

// New York springs forward at 02:00 on 8 March 2026: the day has 23 hours.
// Slots stay wall-clock slots (02:00–03:00 is skipped by the clocks), a
// drag or a click there lands on the first real instant after the gap, and
// the daily 09:00 series stays at 09:00 on both sides of the switch.
const appointments = [
  {
    id: 1,
    text: 'Night shift (1½ real hours)',
    startDate: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 2, 8, 6, 0)), // 01:00 EST
    endDate: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 2, 8, 7, 30)), // 03:30 EDT
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    text: 'Daily check-in',
    startDate: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 2, 6, 14, 0)), // 09:00 EST
    endDate: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 2, 6, 14, 30)),
    recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=5',
    startTimeZone: 'America/New_York',
  },
];

export function SpringForward() {
  const [clicked, setClicked] = useState('—');
  return (
    <>
      <OgeScheduler
        dataSource={appointments}
        defaultCurrentDate={new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 2, 8, 17))}
        defaultCurrentView="day"
        views={['day', 'week']}
        timeZone="America/New_York"
        scrollTime={0}
        onCellClick={(event) => setClicked(event.cellDate.toISOString())}
        style={{ height: 560 }}
      />
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm" aria-live="polite">
        Last clicked slot (UTC): {clicked}
      </p>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Timelines & custom intervals

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';
import type { OgeSchedulerView, OgeSchedulerViewOptions } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

// intervalCount turns any view into an N-period view: a 3-day view, a
// fortnight, and the month / year timelines at day scale. Navigation steps
// by the whole interval; week numbers follow ISO 8601 by default.
const views: (OgeSchedulerView | OgeSchedulerViewOptions)[] = [
  { type: 'day', intervalCount: 3, name: '3 days' },
  { type: 'week', intervalCount: 2, name: 'Fortnight' },
  'month',
  'timelineWorkWeek',

    id: 1,
```

### Multi-level groups

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeScheduler } from '@oge-ui/react-scheduler';

// groups nests the levels, outermost first: owners inside rooms.
// groupByDate={false} lays each resource's days side by side; the render
// prop replaces every grouped header (level 0 = rooms).
const resources = [
  {
    fieldExpr: 'roomId',
    label: 'Room',
    items: [
      { id: 'north', text: 'North room' },

      { id: 'grace', text: 'Grace', color: '#0891b2' },
      { id: 'linus', text: 'Linus', color: '#16a34a' },
    ],
  },
];

  {
    id: 1,
    text: 'Daily standup',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 3, 9, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 3, 9, 15),
    recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=DAILY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR',
    ownerId: 'ada',
    roomId: 'north',
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    text: 'Design pairing',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 10, 0),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 12, 0),
    ownerId: 'grace',
    roomId: 'north',
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    text: 'Release prep',
    startDate: new Date(2026, 7, 6, 13, 0),

    roomId: 'south',

      dataSource={appointments}

      groups={['roomId', 'ownerId']}

      dayEndHour={18}

        <span className={level === 0 ? 'font-semibold' : undefined}>{item.text}</span>
      )}
      style={{ height: 600 }}
    />
  );
```

```ts
// A full day folds into "+N more": a Tab-reachable button that opens the
```
